ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Rare Books and Special Collections Librarianship] LEEP students; Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis with the consent of Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@illinois.edu). Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.continuinged.illinois.edu/outreach/. Required on-campus section Friday, March 4. See section description for 590RB at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog . Meets first half session: Jan. 18 - March 8. Required course for Graduate Certificate in Special Collections.
